sources.title: Maison Troisgros — Access & reservations
sources.claim: Troisgros lists Taxi Dufourt (06 09 37 17 65) and Taxi Christian (06 09 43 36 62) and recommends booking transport with the reservation.

sources.title: Le Bois Dormant — Hotel Troisgros
sources.claim: 15 rooms, 17-hectare estate, Relais & Châteaux.

sources.title: Le Pré Cheval — Troisgros estate gîtes
sources.claim: Marion Troisgros's three farm gîtes on the family estate.

sources.title: Le Pré Cheval — Lodging rates
sources.claim: Petit Pied-à-terre €220, Grand €320; self check-in from 16:30.

sources.title: Château d'Origny
sources.claim: 16th-century château with five suites and a free shuttle to Troisgros.

sources.title: Château d'Origny — Restaurant
sources.claim: Michelin-starred restaurant under chef Julien Laval since 2023.

sources.title: Domaine d'Aromm
sources.claim: 27-ha equestrian estate; €125–165; étape dîner package €155 pp.

sources.title: Domaine Bérenguer (Gîtes de France)
sources.claim: Three rooms, €130 double, sequoia park, private pool.

sources.title: Les Cabanes du Grand Nord
sources.claim: Three Finnish kotas — Canada, Laponie, Alaska — with private jacuzzis under cover.

sources.title: Domaine des Grands Cèdres
sources.claim: Treehouses above Cordelle with private hot tubs and heated pool.

sources.title: Château de Champlong
sources.claim: 4★ château with 12 spice-themed rooms, golf, spa; ⚠ closed Sun/Mon evenings.

sources.title: Saint-Haon-le-Châtel
sources.claim: 14th-c capital of Roannais; only Loire commune bounded by its full medieval enclosure.

sources.title: Prieuré d'Ambierle
sources.claim: Cluniac priory with a 1466 polyptych attributed to the workshop of Rogier van der Weyden.

sources.title: Charlieu Benedictine Abbey
sources.claim: €5 / €4 reduced; +€3 guided; closed Tuesdays; May hours 10:00–13:00 / 14:00–18:00.

sources.title: Charlieu Abbey — Tourist office
sources.claim: 12th-c grand portal rated a Romanesque masterpiece.

sources.title: Couvent des Cordeliers
sources.claim: Franciscan convent across the Sornin from Charlieu Abbey.

sources.title: Bateau-promenade Lac de Villerest
sources.claim: 09:00 Villerest → Château de la Roche cruise (3h30 return) Wed/Sun only; reservation mandatory.

sources.title: Château de la Roche
sources.claim: Castle on a 437 m rocky pinnacle above the Loire gorges.

sources.title: Belvédère de Commelle-Vernay
sources.claim: Free belvedere over the Villerest dam with sundial and orientation table.

sources.title: Belvédère Aventures (railbikes)
sources.claim: 4-seat electric railbikes; 6.8 km / 1h30; 2026 season opens 4 April.

sources.title: Domaine Sérol — Visits & tastings
sources.claim: Free tastings Mon–Sat 9–12 + 14–19; closed Sun & holidays.

sources.title: Domaine des Pothiers
sources.claim: Mon–Fri 9–12 / 13–17; Saturday by appointment only; closed Sundays.

sources.title: Mons Fromager — Halles Diderot
sources.claim: Sunday 9:00–12:00 at Roanne Halles Diderot.

sources.title: Roanne — market hours
sources.claim: Halles Diderot Tue–Sun 8–19; Sunday 8–noon.

sources.title: Charlieu — market hours
sources.claim: Charlieu market Wed and Sat mornings only.

sources.title: Maison Pralus
sources.claim: Founded Roanne 1948; original 1955 Praluline pink-praline brioche.

sources.title: Pralus — Halles Diderot
sources.claim: Pralus boutique inside Les Halles Diderot.

sources.title: Villages de Caractère en Loire (Roannais)
sources.claim: Five villages: Saint-Haon-le-Châtel, Saint-Jean-Saint-Maurice-sur-Loire, Ambierle, Perreux and Le Crozet.

sources.title: Musée Alice Taverne
sources.claim: 18th-c house recreating Roannais–Forez rural life 1850–1940.

sources.title: Musée Joseph Déchelette
sources.claim: €5 / €2.80; free Wed PM and 1st Sun of month.

sources.title: Fête de la Science 2026
sources.claim: Village des Sciences Roanne 2–12 October 2026.

sources.title: SIDO Lyon
sources.claim: Annual IoT/AI/XR/robotics conference in Lyon (September); ~85 km from Troisgros.

sources.title: Gault&Millau — Hotel Troisgros
sources.claim: Le Bois Dormant rooms from €300/night.

sources.title: Relais & Châteaux — Troisgros
sources.claim: Relais & Châteaux member continuously since 1966.

sources.title: TripAdvisor — Hotel Troisgros
sources.claim: 4.6/5 across 375 reviews; #1 of 1 hotels in Ouches.

sources.title: Michelin Guide — Troisgros Le Bois sans Feuilles
sources.claim: Three-star restaurant in Ouches; 8 km west of Roanne.

sources.title: Mons cheese — affinage tunnel at Ambierle
sources.claim: Hervé Mons ages cheese in a rehabilitated 180 m former railway tunnel at Ambierle.

sources.title: Domaine Sérol — home
sources.claim: Biodynamic Gamay Saint-Romain producer in Renaison, Côte Roannaise.

sources.title: Le Crozet — village
sources.claim: 12th-c keep and 13th-c Maison de Bois; 'Village de Caractère en Loire'.

sources.title: Saint-Jean-Saint-Maurice-sur-Loire
sources.claim: 17 m Tour de Saint-Maurice keep on the pilgrim route; boat from Villerest stops here.

sources.title: Rogier van der Weyden — Wikipedia
sources.claim: Flemish painter (c.1400–1464); the Ambierle 1466 polyptych is attributed to his workshop.
